name: orbit
description: Free, open-source realtime task manager with issues, boards, sprints, projects, docs and files, including a hosted MCP server for AI agents.
primary_function: Lets AI agents manage Orbit issues, projects, sprints, docs and files through a workspace-scoped OAuth MCP connection.

name: ida-pro-mcp
description: Local-first, deterministic MCP server for IDA Pro and IDA Home with 109 strict-schema reverse-engineering operations, evidence-backed findings and policy-gated IDB edits.
primary_function: Exposes IDA Pro/Home reverse-engineering operations to AI clients through MCP.

name: mcp-trendpulse
description: Local/community stdio MCP server for Google News research, article extraction and Google Trends analysis.
primary_function: Provides Google News and Google Trends research tools for keywords, markets, SEO and content analysis.

name: ruagentic-directory
description: Hosted MCP endpoint for searching RUAGENTIC's public directory of MCP servers, MCP clients and AI agents.
primary_function: Provides read-only search_directory and get_listing tools for MCP and agent discovery.

name: corpusiq-docs
description: Remote MCP server for authenticated access to business data across 40+ connectors including QuickBooks, Shopify, Gmail and GA4.
primary_function: Lets AI clients query connected business systems through a remote OAuth MCP endpoint.

name: fabling
description: Hosted MCP server for Spanish and French learning data, including saved vocabulary, grammar evidence, recent practice and practice focus.
primary_function: Lets connected AI assistants read a user's language-learning state and, with separate write permissions, update word status and practice progress.

name: nanoparse-mcp
description: Hosted web-content extraction MCP with clean Markdown, page metadata and Litmus source-intelligence signals. The older local npm client is retired; use the hosted endpoint.
primary_function: Lets AI assistants parse public URLs into structured Markdown and source-trust metadata through a remote pay-per-parse MCP service.

name: shipvela-codex
description: Hosted Shipvela MCP for owner-authorized website publishing, staging, deployment status and build logs. OAuth is required; the linked MIT repository contains client/plugin materials, not the proprietary hosted server source.
primary_function: Lets AI coding assistants manage and publish websites to Shipvela through a remote, owner-approved OAuth MCP connection.

name: skyaccess-mcp
description: Hosted MCP for private-jet empty-leg flight search, flight details, charter estimates and booking handoff links. Public search is documented as not requiring an account or API key.
primary_function: Lets AI assistants find available empty-leg flights, inspect flight details and estimate charters via a remote MCP endpoint.

name: surveysparrow-mcp
description: Official hosted SurveySparrow MCP connection for survey creation, publishing, sharing, responses and analysis. Requires per-user SurveySparrow OAuth authorization.
primary_function: Lets authorized AI assistants manage surveys and inspect response data through SurveySparrow's hosted Streamable HTTP MCP.

name: flashcrafter-growth-briefs
description: Private hosted Growth Briefs MCP for authorized local-business market, competitor, online visibility and reputation research. Requires a FlashCrafter account and approved business access; hosted server source is not public.
primary_function: Lets authorized users access and review their private FlashCrafter local-business growth research in an MCP client.

name: folklore-mcp
description: Official public, read-only Helena Folklore MCP for GRCh38 germline variant evidence, ACMG/AMP explanations, gene-disease research and biomedical literature. Not a diagnostic or patient-specific clinical service.
primary_function: Lets AI clients research public germline variant evidence and related literature; professional review is required for clinical interpretation.

name: mcp
description: Official remote Arcmira MCP for YouTube and podcast transcript search, timestamped quotations, entity mentions, sponsors and monitoring. Sign-in via OAuth or a user-provided API key; some operations consume credits.
primary_function: Lets AI agents search and investigate indexed video and podcast transcripts with source attribution through an account-scoped MCP connection.

name: stivio-mcp
description: Hosted Stivio MCP for comparing video models, quoting generation costs, uploading images and generating or tracking AI videos. Generation spends user credits and requires a personal Bearer key; the /mcp web page is documentation, not the MCP endpoint.
primary_function: Lets authenticated AI clients create image-to-video and text-to-video outputs after reviewing generation cost and authorizing use of credits.

name: superdirector-mcp
description: Hosted OAuth MCP offering Instagram and TikTok profile research, Brand DNA, competitor discovery, content ideas and production briefs. Read/status tools may be free; other workflows depend on credits or plan permissions.
primary_function: Lets authorized AI assistants conduct social-video brand research and generate content briefs through a remote OAuth MCP connection.

name: deals
description: Public read-only UK shopping MCP for discount codes, price drops, phones and SIM deals, local events, airport parking and software comparisons. No account needed; some shopping links may earn affiliate commissions.
primary_function: Lets AI clients look up UK deals and prices through Vouchernaut's public Streamable HTTP endpoint.
